popCulture.title: Cymodoce (mythology)
popCulture.description: Wave-calming Nereid — Hesiod's catalogue name whom Virgil later summons among the sea-nymphs aiding Aeneas' fleet.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: In Book 10 Virgil names Cymodoce among the Nereids who become sea-nymphs of Aeneas' transformed ships — Homeric catalogue made Augustan epic.
